# vendor/

Third-party libraries, served from this site rather than a CDN so the page
works on networks that block CDNs and loads no third-party code.

| File | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | pdf.js 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | pdf-lib 1.17.1 | MIT |

pdf.js renders PDF pages; pdf-lib writes the compressed PDF back out.
